text:
Nora (People Ops): Quick policy check: Sam booked long-term airport parking for a 5-day customer trip and paid $65 on his personal card. His return got pushed 2 extra days due to meeting changes, so the parking ended up $95. He submitted both receipts. Are we good to reimburse the extra days?

Sam (Sales): I usually aim for economy parking but this airport only had a long-term lot. Manager approved the trip and the schedule change happened mid-trip.

Diego (Finance): Parking is reimbursable if it's directly tied to a business trip. For schedule changes that extend the trip, we reimburse additional parking days provided there's documentation showing the extension (calendar invite updates, manager note).

Nora (People Ops): What docs exactly do we need? The receipts show two charges (initial and additional) but some garages combine into one charge and the timestamp doesn't show duration.

Diego (Finance): Preferred: itemized garage receipts showing entry/exit or a single receipt with line items. If not available, accept: 1) card statement showing charge(s), 2) a screenshot of booking confirmation or parking ticket with entry date, and 3) a manager email confirming the trip extension. Attach all to the expense.

Sam (Sales): Manager already emailed approval for the schedule change. I'll attach that. Do we need People Ops sign-off because it's >$75?

Nora (People Ops): Our threshold: individual incidental items <= $100 are manager-approvable. Over $100 requires People Ops review. This is $95 so manager-only is OK. If we spot repeat patterns (multiple extended parkings) we'll flag for travel coaching.

travel-bot: Policy snippet: "Ground transportation & parking: reimbursable when incurred for business travel. Extended stays due to schedule changes require manager approval and supporting documentation." See internal travel policy link. :link:

Diego (Finance): When coding, use: "Travel > Ground - Parking (airport)" and include the trip name and dates in the description for reconciliation. We'll process once attachments are uploaded.

Nora (People Ops): GreatI'll tell Sam to upload the manager email + receipts and we'll close the ticket. Thanks! :thumbsup:
